text: 特朗普政府已同意为电池及关键矿产生产企业提供超 20 亿美元资金，进一步加码政府资金投入，目标是摆脱美国对中国供应商的依赖。媒体援引白宫官员报道称，特朗普总统计划在周五与矿业高管举行的圆桌会议上宣布，国防部已承诺向下一代电池企业西拉纳米技术公司提供14亿美元贷款，并与另外三家企业签署协议。
text_en: The Trump administration has agreed to provide over $2 billion in funding for battery and critical mineral producers, further stepping up government investment with the goal of reducing US reliance on Chinese suppliers. Citing White House officials, media reported that President Trump plans to announce at a roundtable with mining executives on Friday that the Defense Department has committed to a $1.4 billion loan to next-generation battery maker Sila Nanotechnologies, and has signed agreements with three other companies.
